evals.name: create-overview-design
evals.prompt: Create an overall system design document for the project with architecture diagrams
evals.expected_output: A complete docs/design/README.md file with system overview, architecture flowchart, modules table, technical decisions, and data model class diagram

evals.name: create-module-design
evals.prompt: Create a detailed design document for the auth module with appropriate mermaid diagrams
evals.expected_output: A complete docs/design/auth/README.md file with module overview, component diagram, sequence diagram for authentication flow, state diagram for auth states, and public API documentation

evals.name: check-docs-sync
evals.prompt: Check if design documents need updates after adding a new payment feature to the project
evals.expected_output: An analysis report identifying which design documents need updates (e.g., docs/design/README.md for new module entry, docs/design/payment/README.md for new module design)
